title: Your parents, by element
caption:
Every household runs on one of four combos. Which one raised you?

Fire and Water: one runs the calendar, one keeps the peace. Air and Earth: one invites the whole street, one bought extra rice on Tuesday. Fire and Earth: very punctual, very long discussions. Air and Water: a very happy, slightly late house.

Send this to your sibling and agree on your parents' combo. Then get your parents to take the test.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
